# Orange Cloud

> Personal project by Cường Lê Sỹ (GitHub @sycu8): demos and Vietnamese learning resources built on the Cloudflare Developer Platform. Not a publication of Cloudflare, Inc.; not endorsed or reviewed by Cloudflare.

## About
- [Giới thiệu / About](https://orangecloud.vn/about/): who maintains the site, professional-context disclosure, contact
- [Status](https://orangecloud.vn/status/): live domain status and rolling uptime
- [Legal notice](https://orangecloud.vn/#legal): non-affiliation and trademark notice

## Learning (Vietnamese)
- [OrangeCloud Onboarding](https://onboarding.orangecloud.vn/): learn Cloudflare from zero (DNS, SSL/TLS, CDN, Workers, Zero Trust)
- [Onboarding blog](https://onboarding.orangecloud.vn/blog/): beginner explainers with FAQs

## News (Vietnamese)
- [OrangeCloud Insights](https://blog.orangecloud.vn/): AI-assisted Vietnamese summaries of security, cloud and AI news, with links to original sources
- [RSS](https://blog.orangecloud.vn/feed.xml)

## Tools
- [CF Ready](https://ready.orangecloud.vn/): open-source Cloudflare go-live readiness CLI (`npx @orangecloud/cf-ready scan`)
- [Edge coverage](https://orangecloud.vn/tools/edge-coverage/): DNS, resolver comparison, and on-page CDN notes. Short host: https://lookup.orangecloud.vn/

## Projects
- [Project index](https://orangecloud.vn/#projects): one hub page per project, under https://orangecloud.vn/projects/
- [FireTrace](https://firetrace.orangecloud.vn/): satellite hotspot map for Vietnam. A hotspot is not a confirmed fire. Live site only.
- [AnCư 3D](https://home.orangecloud.vn/): understand a home before calling it home
- [PulseWatch](https://reputation.orangecloud.vn/): public mention monitoring
- [Pregnancy Meal Planner](https://pregnancymeal.tips/): free 7-day Vietnamese pregnancy meal plan. Vietnamese edition: https://pregnancymeal.tips/vi
- [Onboarding](https://onboarding.orangecloud.vn/): learning hub
- [VN Market Daily](https://stocknews.orangecloud.vn/): Vietnam market news desk. Not investment advice.
- [VivaAge](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/): education tool for adults 40+. Not medical or financial advice.
